pada:
atha ShaShTho~adhpAyaH |
atha (pAriSeShyAt) nirUhabastividhimAha - tatra tadBedAnAha -
nirUhabastirbahudhA Bidyate kAraNAntarai: |
taireva tasya nAmAni kRutAti muniShu~ggavaiH ||1|| 
nirUhasyAparaM nAma proktamAsthApanaM budhai: |
svasthAnasthApanAddoShadhAtUnAM sthApanaM matam || 2 ||

vya_text: gU0 - atha nirUhaNabastividhi: | nirUhasya nAmAntaramAha - sa doShanirharaNAda#094D;vA nirUha:, tasya nirUhasya aparam AsthApitaM nAma budhai: doShadhAtUnAM svasthAne sthApanAdvA nAma matam ||1||2||

dI0 - yo nirUhabasti: pUrvaM saMgRuhIta:| so~apyatra kAraNAntarai: kRutvA bahudhA Bidyate kathyata ityartha: | kAraNAntarANi vakShyamANadoShahara-saMSamana-Sodhana-leKana-bRuMhaNAni picCila-yApana-vaitaraNabastipraBUtIniboddhavyAni | taireva kAraNAntaraireva tasyA nirUhabaste: nAmAni munipu~ggavai: RuShiSreShThai: kRutAni kathitAni ityaBiprAyaH, doShaharabastirityAdIni tasya viSeShanAmAnyAha -nirUhasyeti | budhaiH paNDitaiH nirUhasya nAma AsthAnaM proktaM, AsthApayati vaya: iti AsthApanaM paramutkRuShTam utkRuShTatvaM ca vayaHsthApanenaiva | athavA doShadhAtUnAM svasthAne sthApanAdAsthApanaM, tacca kShIreNa kvAthaiSca kriyate| uktaM ca - ‘snehairyo dIyate sa syAdanuvAsananAmaka:| eke `svasthApanaM sthApanAddoShadhAtUnAM sthApanaM matam' iti nAma paThanti vyAKyAnayanti ca | suSrute~api -‘sadoShanirharaNAcCarIrarohaNAdvA nirUha iti so~asthApana iti nAma | asyAmapi nirukta#094C; sa eva | yathA vaya:sthApanAdvA~ayu:sthApanAdvA~a~asthApanaM, tataSca sarvadoShanirharaNAnnirUha iti vamanAdikam ||1||2||

pada:
atha doShAdyapekShayA mAtrAmAha -
nirUhasya pramANaM ca prasthaM pAdottaraM param | 
madhyamaM prasthamuddiShTaM hInaM ca kuDavAstraya: ||3||

vya_text: gU0 – nirUhapramANamAha - nirUhasya pramANaM pAdottaraM vaMkShaNAdhikaM prasthaM mataM, prasthaM madhyamaM mataM, trayaH kuDavA hInaM matam || 3 ||

dI0 - nirUhsya nirUhasaMj~jasyAsthApanasya paramamutkRuShThaM mAnaM pAdottaraM prasthaM sapAdaprasthaM madhyaM prasthaM uddiShTham | traya: kuDavA: hInaM mAnam | uktaM ca pArASare - ‘nirUhasya pramANaM tu prastha: pAdottara: para:| madhyaprasthastu nirdiShTo vij~jeyA: kuDavAstraya:' iti| uttamAdimAnaM ca doShabalApekShayA~avagantavyam | nanu carakAdAvanyathA paThitaM tadyathA - ‘ata UrdhvaM pravakShyAmi nirUhasyopakalpanam | dvAdaSaprastutasyAdau tato~anyAnupakalpayet' iti | tatkathamatra viMSatipalAnyuttamamAtrAyAM pratipAditAni ? | satyam, dvAdaSaprasRutamAno nirUha: pa~jcA~ggamAno yuktyA darSita: | tathAhi - ‘madhusnehanakalkAKyakaShAyA vApyata: kramAt | trINi, ShaT, dve, daSa, trINi palAnyanilarogiNAm || pitte catvAri catvAri tri pa~jca ca catuShTayam | ShaT, trINi, dve, daSa, trINi kaPe cApi nirUhaNam' iti | anyacca – ‘data#094D;vAkShaM saidhavasyAdau madhuna: prasa#0943;tidvayam| vinirmathya tato dadya#093E;tsnehasya prasRutitrayam || ekIBUte tata: snnehe kalkasya prasRutiM kShipet | saMmUrcCite kaShAyaM tu catu:prasRutasaMmitam || vitarecca tathA~avApamante dviprasRutonmitam | vastrapUtaM tathoShNAmbukumBIbAShpena tApita: | evaM prakalpito bastirdvAdaSaprasRuto Bavet || na dhAvatyauShadhaM prANairna tiShThatyavalipya ca| na karoti ca sImAntaM sa nirUha: suyojita' iti | etenotkRuShTadoShabale dvAdaSaprasRutamAna: madhyabale viMSatipalAnItyadoSha: | sAmAnyaviSeShakathanAdadoSha: | svakIyamate sAmAnyaH paramate viSeSha ityadoShaH | yadvA SodhanasaMSamanaleKanapraBRutInAM bastInAM viShayatvena viMSatipraBRutikaM caturviMSatipraBRutikaM mAnamupadiSanti tadanumAnato j~jAtavyaM granthagauravaBayAnna liKitamityadoSha: ||3||

pada:
athAnAsthApanIyAnAha -
atisnigdhotkliShTadoShau kShatoraska: kRuSastathA | 
AdhmAnacCardihikkArSa: kAsaSvAsaprapIDitaH || 4 || 
gudaSoPAtisArArto viShUcIkuShThasaMyutaH | 
garBiNI madhumehI ca nAsthApyaSca jalodarI || 5 ||

vya_text: gU0 - yeShAM na vihitaM tAnAha - vaya:sthApanAdAyuH sthApanAdvA sthApanam AsthApanaSabdena nirUhaNamucyate' tannirUhaNakarma atisnigdhAdInAM na vidhIyate | utkliShTadoSho vamanonmuKadoShaH, kShatamuro yasyAsau kShatoraska:, kRuSo durbalaH, spaShTamanyat || 4 || 5 ||

gU0 - ete nAsthApyAH, cakArAdanuvAsyASca na | uktaMca - ‘BayonmAdastathA SoShAjIrNArucipramehinaH| mUrcCAkuShThodarasthaulyaSvAsakAsakShayAturAH || SothaBramamadacCardiyutA bastyamalAcalAH | nAsthApyA nAnuvAsyASca vAtarogAdRute narAH’ iti | kuShThaSabdenAtra mahAkuShThaM grAhyaM na kShudrakuShThaM tasya vihitatvAt | pramehagrahaNAt sarvaprameheShu hitam | evaM jalodaragrahaNena anyodareShu hitam | uktaM ca - ‘udarI ca pramehI ca kuShThI sthUlaSca mAnavaH | avaSyaM sthApanIyAste nAnuvAsyAsta eva
#foot@-‘kathaMcana’ pA0 |#
 ca’ iti || 4 || 5 ||

pada:
atha nirUhyAnAha -
vAtavyAdhAvudAvarte vAtAsRugviShamajvare | 
mUrcCAtRuShNodarAnAhamUtrakRucCrASmarIShu ca ||6|| 
vRuddhAsRugdaramandAgniprameheShu nirUhaNam | 
SUle~amlapitte hRudroge yojayedvidhivadbudha: || 7 ||

vya_text: gU0 - yeShAM nirUhaNaM vihitaM tAnAha - vAtavyAdhau vAtaroge, udAvarte udAvartaroga#0947; tathAsRugdararogAdau nirUhaNaM yojayet | jalodare niShedhaH nAnyasmin udare || 6 || 7||

dI0 - vAtavyAdhAviti | vAtavyAdhyAdiShu nirUhaNam AsthApanasaMj~jaM yojayet | vAtavyAdhiH AkShepakAdi:, udAvarta udarApUra:, vAtAsRuk vAtaraktaM, viShamajvara: ekAhikAdi:, udaramatra jalodaravyatiriktaM sarvodaraM grAhyam | eke - ‘mUtrakRucCrodarAnAhamUtradoShASmarIShu ca’ iti paThanti | tatra mUtradoShaM mUtrAGAtamapi j~jeyam | athavA mUtragrahaNena strINAmapi mUtraretorajodoShA api gRuhyante | yaduktaM – ‘mUtraretorajodoShAn asRugdaragrahaNaM premeheShu ityatrApi madhumehavyatirekeNAnye pramehA grAhyA:| tasa#094D;ya niShiddhatvAt | vidhivadityanena tantrAntaroktavidhAnaM ba#094B;ddhavyam | tadyathA - `nAtyucCritaM nApyatinIcapAdaM sapAdapIThaM SayanaM praSastam | pradhAnamRudvAstaraNopapannaM prAkSIrShakaM SuklapaTottarIyam || prakShipya bastau mathitaM Kajena subaddhapucCAsya ca nirvalIkam | A~gga#0941;ShThamadhyena muKaM pidhAya netrAgrasaMsthAmapanIya vartim | tailAktagAtraM kRutamUtraviTkaM nAtikShudhArtaM Sayane manuShyam || samethaveShannataSairase vA nAta#094D;yucCrite svAstaraNopapanne | savyena pArSvena suKaM SayAnaM kRutvA jayedasya BujopanAham || niShku~jcya savyetaradasya sakthiM vAmaM prasArya praNayecca bastim | snnigdhe gude netracaturthaBAgaM snnigdhairjanairjAnu ca pRuShThavaMSam || akampanA~avepanalAGavAdIn pANya~ggulIScApi nidarSayanti | prapIDya caikagrahaNena datte netraM Sanaireva tato~apakarShayet || tiryakpraNItena tu yAtidhArA gude vraNa: syAccalite ca netre | datta: Sanaira#094D;nASayameti basti: kaNThaM pradhAvatyatipIDitastu' ityAdi ||6||7||

pada:
yena prakAreNa nirUhaNaM kartavyaM tadAha - utsRuShTAnilaviNmUtraM snigdhasvinnamaBojitam | 
madhyAhne gRuhamadhye ca yathAyogyaM nirUhayet || 8 || 
snnehabastividhAnena budhaH kuryAnnirUhaNam | 
jAte nirUhe ca tato BavedutkaTakAsanaH || 9 ||
tiShThenmuhUrtamAtraM tu nirUhAgamanecCayA | 
anAyAtaM muhUrtaM tu nirUhaM Sodhanairharet ||10|| 
nirUhaireva matimAnkShAramUtrAmlasaindhavaiH |

vya_text: gU0 - evam utsRuShTAnilamUtrAdilakShaNaM nirUhayet | yathAyogyaM yathAvihitam utsRuShTaH niHsRutaH anilo vAyurviT purIShaM, mUtraM ca yasya tam | snigdhaM snehitaM, svinnaM sveditam, aBojitam akRutAhAraM, madhyAhne madhyAhnakAle gRuhamadhye gRuhAByantare | nirUhaNaM kena vidhinA kuryAdityAha -pUrvokto yaH snehabastistadvidhAnena budhaH nirUhaNaM kuryAt | nirUhe jAte utkaTakAsanaH utkaTaM Bavet | punaH nirUhAgamanecCayA muhUrtamAtraM tiShThet | muhUrtAt anAyAntaM nirUhaM tataH SodhanairnirUhai: kShAramUtrAmlasaindhavaireva Sodhayet || 8-10 ||

dI0 - evaMvidhaM nirUhayet | utsaShTetyAdi | utsaShTaM parityaktaM vAtamUtrapurIShaM yena | snigdhaM kRutasnehanaM | svinnaM sveditam | aBojitamakRutaBojanaM | madhyAhneti tasyocitakAlatvaKyApanArtham | gRuhamadhye iti | vAtAtaparajodoShAdinirAsArtham | snehabastividhAnaM pUrvamevAnuvAsanAdhyAye uktam | budhagrahaNaM nirUhadAne~atikuSalatvaKyApanArtham | nirUhadAnAnantaraM kiM kartavyam ? ityata Aha - jAte iti | anAyate nirUhaM SodhanairnirUhairharet | SodhananirUhAH kShArAdiBiH kartavyAH | utkaTakAsanaH UrdhvajAnusthitaH muhUrtaM GaTikAdvayaparyantam | yadA muhUrtAdupari anAyAtaM nirUhaM syAt, tadA SodhanairnirUhaiH kRutvA AharetkShAramUtrAmlasaindhavairnirUhaNairiti saMbandhaH || anAyAtasya vyApattiruktA cakradatte - ‘aSuddhaSca malonmiSraH sreho naiti yadA punaH | tadA~gge sadanAdhmAnaSUlA: SvAsaSca jAyate || pakvASayagurutvaM ca tatra dadyAnnirUhaNam | tIkShNaM tIkShNauShadhairevaM siddhaM cApyanuvAsanam’ iti || 8-10 ||

pada:
atha sunirUDhalakShaNamAha -
yasya krameNa gacCanti viTpittakaPavAyavaH | 
lAGavaM copajAyeta sunirUhaM tamAdiSet ||11 ||

vya_text: dI0 - yasya krameNa tantrAntarokte~agnimUtrapittakaPavAyavaH gacCanti lAGavaM copajAyate sunirUhaM tamAdiSet | uktaM ca dRuDhabalena - ‘prasRuShTaviNmUtrasamIraNatvaM rucyagnivRudhyASayalAGavAni | rogopaSAMtiH prakRutisthatA ca balaM ca tatsyAtsunirUDhali~ggam’ iti | sunirUDhamityAdinA caikadvitripraBRutinirUhadAnaviShayamuktam | uktaM ca - ‘eko~apakarShatyanilaM svamArgAtpittaM dvitIyastu kaPaM tRutIya’ ityAdi || 11 ||

pada:
atha durnirUhalakShaNamAha --
yasya syAdvastiralpAlpavego hInamalAnilaH | 
mUrcCArtijADyArujimAn durnirUhaM tamAdiSet ||12||

vya_text: gU0 – durnirUhalakShaNamAha - AsthApanasnehabastyo: samyagdAne lakShaNamAha - viviktatA ekAntatA, manastuShTiH manasaH saMtoShaH, snigdhatA sacikkaNatA, vyAdhinigrahaH roganASaH | AsthApitaM nirUhaNaM | snehabastiH pUrvoktaH, tayoH samyagdAne idaM lakShaNam ||12||

dI0 - alpAlpavega iti | bastidAnena svalpadravAnAmantaH praveSananiShayaH | uktaM ca - ‘dattaH SanairnASayameti bastiH kaNThaM pradhAvatyatipIDitastu’ iti | etena tUrNamavalambitamiti | hInamala iti hInamalo bastirityarthaH | na purIShAdinirgamaH | yataH - ‘alpAlpavego viDvAtahIno hInanirUhaNaH | mUrcCAcCardikaPaprAyo mahAvego~atiSabditaH’ iti | mUrcCArtijADyArucimAn iti | mUrcCAsthAne mUtrArtiriti pAThAntaram | jADyaM jaDatA kaPaprAyetyaBiprAyaH | kecida- trAsthApanasnehabastyoH samyagdAnalakShaNaM paThanti | tadyathA -
‘viviktatA manastuShTiH snigdhatA vyAdhinigrahaH | 
AsthApanasnehabastyoH samyagdAne tu lakShaNam’ iti || 
viviktatA manastuShTiH | sugamamanyat || 12 ||

pada:
nirUhasya bastidAnavaddeyatAmAha -
anena vidhinA yu~jjyAnnirUhaM bastidAnavat | 
dvitIyaM vA tRutIyaM vA caturthaM vA yathocitam || 13||

vya_text: gU0 - anena vidhinA bastidAnavit nirUhaM yu~jjyAt | nirUhasya dvitIyAdiyojanavidhimAha - ekaM nirUhaM dvitIyaM vA caturthaM nirUhaM vA yathocitaM yathAdoShaM yu~jjyAt | tatra nirUhayojane doShakramamAha - pavane vAte ekaH nirUhaH sasneha eva | dvau nirUho pitte payasA dugdhena saha | kaShAyakaTurUkShAdyAH kaPe trayaH koShNAH || 13 ||

dI0 - anena pUrvoktena vidhinA nirUha bastidAnavat bastidAnatulyaM, vAgrahaNAt prathamam ekaM, paScAddvitIyaM, tadanantaraM tRutIyaM caturthaM ca | etena bastipuTakaM kathitamiti BAvaH | caturthaM vA yathocitamiti | yathArhamiti | nanu tRutIyAdhikapuTamaniShiddham | yathA - ‘snigdhoShNa ekaH pavane nirUho dvau svAduSItau payasA ca pitte | trayaH samUtrAH kaTukoShNatIkShNAH kaPe nirUhA na paraM vidheyAH’ iti | naivaM, niShedho bahupuruShaviShayatayA prAyikaH, caturthapuTadAnaM tu kasminnapi krUrakoShThe balIyasi bahudoShe puruShe, tataH kuto virodhaH | kecidatrAmuM SlokaM paThanti -
sasneha ekaH pavane, pitte dvau payasA saha | 
kaShAyakaTumUtrADhyA: #foot@ - ‘rUkShAdyA’ pA.# kaPe koShNAstrayo hitAH ||
asyArthaH pUrvameva pratipakShe darSitaH tenAtra kairapi paThitaH || 13 ||

pada:
atha BojanakramamAha - 
pittaSleShmAnilAviShTaM kShIrayUSharasaiH kramAt | 
nirUhaM BojayitvA ca tatastamanuvAsayet || 14 ||

vya_text: gU0 - pittaSleShmAnilAviShTaM nirUhaM yojayet kramAt kShIrayUSharasaiH | pittAviShTaM kShIraiH, SleShmAviShTaM yUShaiH, anilAviShTaM rasaiH | evaM nirUhaM yojayitvA paScAdanuvAsanaM kArayet || 14 ||

dI0 - pittAdInAmatra kShIrayUSharasaiH saha BojanaM kAryam | kramAditi anukrameNaiva | anukramo yathA - pittAviShTaM nirUhaM kShIrodanaM BojayitvA paScAdanuvAsayet, bRuMhaNArthamiti BAvaH | SleShmAviShTaM yUShodanaM BojayitvA paScAdanuvAsanaM deyam | anilAviShTaM mAMsarasaudanaM BojayitvA anuvAsayediti padArthaH | uktaM ca - 'pratyAgate koShNajalAvasiktaH SAlyannamadyAttanunA rasena | jIrNe ca sAyaM laGu cAlpamAtraM Bukto~anuvAsya: paribRuMhaNArtham’ iti || 14 ||

pada:
idAnIM bAlavRuddhayormRudubastimAha -
sukumArasya vRuddhasya bAlasya ca mRudurhitaH | 
bastistIkShNaH prayuktastu teShAM hanyAdbalAyuShI ||15||

vya_text: gU0 - kIdRuSaM nirUhaM yu~jjyAt ? tadAha - sukumArAdermRudurbastirhitaH | tIkShNabastisteShAM balAyuShI ||15||

dI0 - sukumArAdInAM mRudurbastirhitaH | 'tu’ punaH tIkShNaH bastiH prayuktaH teShAM balAyuShI hanyAt | tantrAntare viSeShaH | ‘viSeShAtsukumArANAM hIna eva kramo hitaH | mRudurbastiH prayoktavyo viSeShAdbAlavRuddhayoH’ iti || 15 ||

pada:
idAnIM bastInAM dAnakramamAha -
dadyAdutkleSanaM pUrvaM madhye doShaharaM tataH |
paScAt saMSamanIyaM ca dadyAdbastiM vicakShaNaH || 16 ||

vya_text: gU0 - Adau madhye ante ca kIdRuSaM basti yu~jjyAt ? tadAha - utkleSanaM dadyAt ukleSanaM doShotkleSakaraM, madhye doShaharaM vAtAdidoShaSamanaM, paScAt saMSamanIyaM samasthApakaM upaSamakaramityarthaH || 16 ||
dI0 - utkleSanaM doShANAM, doShaharaM tridoShaGnaM, saMSamanaM doShANAM samIkaraNAcCamanam | SeShaM sugamam ||16||

pada:
atha teShAM svarUpANyAha --
utkleSanabastiH |
eraNDabIjaM madhukaM pippalI saindhavaM vacA |
hapuShA PalakalkaM ca bastirutkleSanaH smRutaH ||17||

vya_text: gU0 - madhukaM guDapuShpaM, hapuShA prasiddhA || 17 ||
dI0 - ayamutkleSanasaMj~jo bastiH SeShaM sugamam ||17 ||

pada:
atha doShaharabastimAha -
SatAhvA madhukaM bilvaM kauTajaM Palameva ca |
sakA~jjikaH sagomUtro bastirdoShaharo mataH || 18||

vya_text: gU0 - madhukaM guDapuShpaM, kauTajaM Palam indrayavaH ||18||

pada:
atha teShAM doShaharamAha --
priya~ggu madhukaM mustaM tathaiva ca rasA~jjanam |
sakShIraH Sasyate bastirdoShANAM SamanaH smRutaH ||19||

vya_text: dI0 - ayaM doShasaMSamano bastiH | priya~gguH kAntA, rasA~jjanamatra kRuShNapAShANasadRuSaM dravaviSeShaH | tadaBAve dArvIkvAthasamudBavaM yojyam || 19 ||

pada:
SodhanabastimAha -
Sodhanadravyani:kvAthaistatkalkaiH snehsaindhavaiH |
yuktyA Kajena mathitA bastaya: SodhanA: smRutA: ||20||

vya_text: dI0 - SodhanadravyANi nikumBAdIni prasiddhAni | tAni nikumBa-triPalA-gavakShIra-snuk-SaMKinI-nIlinI-tilvakAni, SamyAka-kampillaka-hemadugdhA-dugdhaM ca virecanAni ityAdIni | ‘Kajena’ ityatra ‘kShaNena’ iti pAThaH sAdhuH || 20 ||

pada:
leKanabastimAha -
triPalAkkAthagomUtrakShaudrakShArasamAyutAH | 
uShakAdipratIvApA bastayo leKanAH smRutAH ||21||

vya_text: gU0 - athe leKanabastayaH - kShAro yavakShAraH | uShakAdirgaNaH suSrute | leKanA medorogAdikRuSIkaraNAt || 21 ||
dI0 - uShakAdiH prAguktaH | yathA - oShakAdisaindhavaSilAjatukAsIsadvayahiMgUni truTakaSceti | SeShaM sugamam || 21 ||

pada:
atha bRuMhaNabastInAha -
bRuMhaNadravyaniShkvAthA: kalkairmadhurakairyutAH |
sarpirmAMsarasopetA bastayo bRuMhaNAH smRutAH || 22 ||

vya_text: gU0 - bRuMhaNA bastayaH matAH kathitAH || 22 ||
dI0 - bRuMhaNAni kAkolI-kShIrakAkolI-jIvakarShaBaka-medA-mahAmedApraBRutIni madhurakairiti | drAkShA-KarjUra-vAtAmadIni || SeShaM subodham || 22 ||

pada:
picCilabastimAha -
badaryai-rAvatI-Selu-SAlmalI-dhanvanAgarAH | 
kShIrasiddhAH kShaudrayuktA nAmrA picCilasaMj~jitAH | 
ajoraBraiNarudhirairyuktA deyA vicakShaNaiH || 23 || 
mAtrA picCilabastInAM palairdvAdaSaBirmatA |

vya_text: gU0 - atha picCilabastayaH - badarI kolam, airAvatI nAgara~ggaPalaM, Selu gundriNI, SAlmalI prasiddhA, dhanvo yavAsaka:, nAgaraM SuNThI | ajA barkarI, uraBra UrNAmeShaH, eNo mRugaH tadrudhireNa deyaH | tatpramANaM dvAdaSapalam || 23 ||

dI0 - badarI prasiddhA (kolam), airAvatI nAgabalA iti BAnumatI, SeluH SleShmAtakaH, SAlmalI prasiddhA, dhanvanAgaro dhanvadeSajo nAgaramustam | dhanvanAgarasthAne ‘dhanvanAkurAH’ iti pAThaH, dhanvayAsakAMkurAH || ajaH CAga:, uraBro meSha:, eNaH kRuShNamRugaH | eke suSrutAdhyAyino~atra paThanti - ‘varAhamahiShoraBrabaiDAlaiNeyakaukkuTam | sadyaskamasRugAjaM vA deyaM picCilabastiShu’ iti | tathA vyAKyAnayanti ca | kShepako~ayamiti manyamAnatvAt na samyak liKitaH | mAtrApicCilabastInAmiti | dvAdaSapalairevAtra pUrmoktA hInamAtrA niyatA viSeShagrahaNAt ||23||

pada:
atha nirUhArthaM dravyANAM parimANapUrvakaM vidhAnamAha -
dattvAdau saindhavasyAkShaM madhunaH prasRutidvayam || 24 || 
vinirmathya tato dadyAtsnehasya prasRutitrayam |
ekIBUte tataH snehe kalkasya prasRutiM kShipet ||25|| 
saMmUrcCite kaShAyaM tu catuHprasRutisaMmitam |
kShiptvA vimathya dadyAcca nirUhaM kulaSo BiShak ||26|| 
vAte catuShpalaM kShaudraM dadyAtsnehasya ShaTpalam |
pitte catuShpalaM kShaudraM snehaM dadyAtpalatrayam || 27 || 
kaPe ca ShaTpalaM kShaudraM kShipetsnehaM catuShpalam |

vya_text: gU0 - atha nirUhaH | saindhavasya akShaM dadyAt | madhunA prasRutidvayaM catu:palaM snehasya tailAde: prasRutitrayaM ShaTpalaM kalakasya dravyasya prasRutiH dvipalam | saMmUrcCite paripakve kaShAye catuHprasRutisaMmitam aShTapalaM kShiptvA vimathya nirUhaM dadyAt, vAte kShaudraM catuHpalaM snehaM catuHpalam evaM viBajya deyam | iti nirUhaNamAtrAvidhi: || 24-27 ||

dI0 - atra saindhavaparimANaM tUttamamAtrAyAM na gaNitam ata eva ‘Adau’ iti grahaNaM kRutam | uttamamAtrA viMSatipalaireva | pUrvamuktaM yathA - ‘nirUhasya pramANaM tu prasthaM pAdottaraM param | madhyamaM prasthamuddiShTaM hInaM tu kuDavAstraya’ iti | cakradatte tu - ‘dattvAkShaM saindhavasyAdau madhunaH prasRutadvayam | vinirmathya tato dadyAtsnehasya prasRutitrayam || ekIBUte tataH snehe kalkasya prasRutiM kShipet | saMmUrcCitaiH kaShAyaM tu catuHprasRutisaMmitam || kShiptvA vimathya dadyAcca nirUhaM kuSalo BiShak | vAte catuHpalaM kShaudraM dadyAtsnehasya ShaTpalam || pitte catuShpalaM kShaudraM snehaM dadyAtpalatrayam | kaPe ca ShaTpalaM kShaudraM kShipet snehaM catuHpalam || vitarecca yathAvApamante dviprasRutonmitam | evaM prakalpito bastirdvAdaSaprasRuto Bavet’ iti | etadapi pa~jcA~ggamAnayuktyA samIcInaM darSitam | tathAhi -‘madhusnehana-kalkAKyakaShAyAvApataH kramAt | trINi ShaT dve daSatrINi palAnyanilarogiNAm | pittaM catvAri catvari tripa~jca ca catuShTayam || ShaT trINi dve daSa trINi kaPe cApi nirUhaNam’ iti | vAtAdInAM kevalamadhusnehayorviSeShamAnamAha - vAte catuHpalaM kShaudram ityAdi | SeShaM sugamam || 24-27 ||

pada:
madhutailikasaMj~jaM bastividhAnamAha - 
eraNDakkAthatulyAMSaM madhutailaM palAMSakam || 28 || 
SatapuShpApalArdhena saindhavArdhena saMyutam |
madhutailakasaMj~jo~ayaM basti: KajaviloDita: || 29 || 
medogulmakRumiplIhamalodAvartanASana:| 
balavarNakaraScaiva vRuShyo dIpanabRuMhaNaH || 30 ||

vya_text: gU0 - SatapuShpA palArdhena yojyA saindhavArdhena ca saMyutaM | madhutailakasaMj~jo~ayaM bastirmedogulmAdiharaH | KajaviloDita iti Kajo manthAnaviSeSha:, tena viloDita: mathitaH || 28-30||

dI0 - madhutailaM palAMSakamityasya sthAne madhutailapalAShTakamityeke paThanti | tanna, uktaM ca tantrAntare - ‘madhutaile same syAtAM kvAthaScairaNDamUlajaH | palArthaM SatapuShpAyAstato~ardhaM saindhavasya ca | palenaikena saMyuktaM Kajena tu viloDita: | deya: suKoShNo BiShajA madhutailasaMkara’ iti | malodAvartanASane ityatra udarodAvartanASana iti pATha: | ayameva tantrAntare ardhamAtrikanirUha: kathita: sa tu tatraiva j~jAtavya: ||28-30||

pada:
atha yApanabastimAha -
kShaudrA-jya-kShIra-tailAnAM prasRutaM prasRutaM Bavet |
hapuShAsaindhavAkShAMSo basti: syAddIpanaH para: || 31 ||

vya_text: gU0 - atha yApanabastimAha - kShaudrAdInAM prasRutirdvipalaM, hapuShA prasiddhA, saindhavaM ca etayorakShAMSau dvau dvau akShau karShau ||31 ||
di0 - hapuShA vipuShA || 31 ||

pada:
atha yuktarathabastimAha -
eraNDamUlaniShkvAtho madhutailaM sasaindhavam |
eSha yuktaratho basti: savacApippallIPalaH || 32 ||

vya_text: gU0 - atha yuktarathabasti: - Palo madanaPalaH, eSha yuktaratho nAma bastiH || 32 ||

dI0 - kvAthAdInAM pariramANaM tu madhutailikabastivajj~jeyam | tasyAntaHpAtitvAt | ‘yaduktaM madhutailaM ca kkAthaM sarasasaindhavam | PalapippalIsaMyukto bastiryuktaratha: smRuta:’ iti | atrA~api pUrvoktameva | Palamatra madanaPalam | iti yuktarathaH || 32 ||

pada:
atha siddhabastimAha -
pa~jcamUlasya niShkvAthastailaM mAgadhikA madhu |
sasaindhava: samadhukaH siddhabastiriti smRuta: || 33 ||

vya_text: gU0 - pa~jcamUlaM bRuhadbilvAdi:, tasya niShkvAtha:, tailaM tilatailaM, mAgadhikA pippalI, madhu kShaudraM, saindhavaM lavaNaM, madhuko madhukasAra iti nAmnA prasiddhaH ||33||
dI0 - sugamam || iti siddhabastinirUha: ||33||

pada:
pathyApathyamAha -
snAnamuShNodakaiH kuryAt divA svapnamajIrNatAm | 
varjayedaparaM sarvam, Acaretsnehabastivat || 34 ||
iti SrIdAmodarasUnunA SAr~ggadhareNa viracitAyAM
SAr~ggadharasaMhitAyAmuttaraKaNDe nirUhabasti-
vidhiradhyAya: samApta: || 6 ||

vya_text:
gU0 - bastau sevyaM niShedhaM ca - uShNodakena snAnaM kuryAt iti vihitam | tathA snehabastau yadvihitaM tadAcaret | divA svApam ajIrNatAM ca varjayet || 34 || 
iti SrIkASirAmavaidyakRutAyAM SAr~ggadharasaMhitATIkAyAM
gUDhArthadIpikAyAmuttaraKaNDe pa~jcakarmaNi
nirUhabastividhiradhyAya: ShaShTha:|| 6||

dI0 - atha tyAjyAnyAha - snehabastivaditi | snehabastividhau yadAcaritaM tatsarvam Acaret | tattatraiva j~jAtavyam || 34 ||
iti SrIvAstavyAnvayaprakASavaidyaBAvasiMhAtmajenADhamallena viracitAyAM SAr~ggadharasaMhitATIkAyAM dIpikAyAmuttaraKaNDe
bastinirUhakalpanAdhyAya: samApta: ||
